department: Data Science, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (Faculty of Science and Faculty of Engineering and Design)

deadline.value: Apply by January 10 for Fall 2027 (Fall entry only).

gre_general.quote: No, a Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

supervisor.value: Contacting potential supervisors first is advised, but you can apply directly to the program.
supervisor.quote: It is always best to reach out to potential supervisors first to confirm that they have openings in their lab for someone with your background and research interests. | It is also possible to apply directly to the program.

funding.value: You are automatically considered for funding (TA, research stipend, scholarships) when you apply; any offer comes with the admission letter, with no guaranteed amount stated.
funding.quote: When submitting an application for admission to Carleton, students are automatically considered for funding and if eligible, will be notified in the Offer of Admission and Funding.

entry_route.value: A master's in data science or a field relevant to the supervisor's home unit, with at least B+ and significant research ability, is the normal requirement.
entry_route.quote: The normal requirement for admission to the DSAAI Ph.D. program is a master's degree in data science or in a discipline relevant to the home unit of the supervisor

notes: Joint program spanning four academic units.
name: PhD in Data Science, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence
